Bridgecreek Investment Management Cut Its B & G Foods Cl A (BGS) Stake as Shares Declined; As Apple (AAPL) Market Value Rose, Hartline Investment Lowered Its Stake
June 1, 2018 - By Nellie Frank
Bridgecreek Investment Management Llc decreased its stake in B & G Foods Inc Cl A (BGS) by 13.65% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bridgecreek Investment Management Llc sold 24,355 shares as the company’s stock declined 12.97% with the market. The institutional investor held 154,015 shares of the consumer non-durables company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $3.65M, down from 178,370 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bridgecreek Investment Management Llc who had been investing in B & G Foods Inc Cl A for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $1.88B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.71% or $0.2 during the last trading session, reaching $28.15. About 1.00 million shares traded. B&G Foods, Inc. (NYSE:BGS) has declined 30.89% since June 1, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 43.46% the S&P500.
Hartline Investment Corp decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 7.43% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hartline Investment Corp sold 8,344 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 104,027 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $17.45M, down from 112,371 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hartline Investment Corp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $918.49B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.34% or $0.63 during the last trading session, reaching $186.87. About 26.72M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
